records.reason: An impulse activity: an area attack resolved at the table against targets' saves; nothing changes the kineticist's own sheet.
Grants a 1-action Strike whose failure effect is a free Step; resolved entirely at the table.
Once-per-month narrative death-replacement resolved by the GM; no statistic on the sheet changes.
An activity: a thrown Strike after which the weapon returns; no sheet statistic changes.
Upgrades a Recall Knowledge success to a critical success and frightens the target; a degree-of-success ruling on a GM-run check plus a target-side condition, no numeric change to the sheet.
An activity that sets the flat-check DC to target a concealed/hidden foe; entirely target-side and table-resolved.
core.json already carries refocusRestore:"all" on this record, which is the refocus lane for regaining the whole focus pool.
A reaction: a Performance check that reduces incoming damage and reflects it; resolved at the table, no persistent sheet statistic.
Spellshape that modifies the next spell's damage and deafens targets; all effects land on the spell's targets.
Applies the countered curse back onto the originator; purely target-side.
A 2-action movement-and-Strike activity resolved at the table.
A finisher activity granting temporary Hit Points on use; a table-resolved action, not a standing sheet value.
An action that heals you and ends the mutagen; resolved when used, no standing statistic.
Modifies the Ricochet Shot activity: bounce surfaces, denies the target cover, and stuns the target; all target-side or table-resolved.
Modifies Ricochet Shot's bounce surfaces and makes the target off-guard once per encounter; target-side and table-resolved.
An exemplar ikon imbue that grants a transcendence activity used against targets at the table; no player statistic changes.
Removes the Command an Animal check for mount move actions and changes when the mount acts; a table/GM procedure with no sheet statistic.
An impulse: area damage, forced movement, and a Swim; all resolved at the table against targets.
Increases how far a Reposition or Shove moves the target; forced-movement distance is target-side and table-resolved, not a sheet statistic.
An activity: a fist Strike that stuns the taunted enemy on a failed save; entirely target-side.
A reaction that quickens an ally; only the ally's statistics change.
An activity: a follow-up unarmed Strike that applies persistent bleed to the target.
A reaction that Strides you and a grabbed creature into water; movement resolved at the table.
An action that combines Mount and Command an Animal; table-resolved, no sheet statistic.
A 2-action activity granting a temporary fly Speed derived from each target's own Speed, mostly to allies; a table-resolved buff, and the value is not a fixed number any speeds field could carry.
An impulse: area damage and forced movement against targets.
An activity combining a reload and a Strike with a misfire risk; resolved at the table.

Adds cursed metamorphosis to the witch familiar's known spells even if it is off-tradition, and lets the player swap a prepared 6th-rank-or-higher witch slot into it. That expands what the player can prepare, but no field adds a specific spell to a prepared caster's available list (innateSpells/focusSpells/spellcastingGrant all model something else).
A polymorph disguise form (plant/fungus) used out of combat and adjudicated by the GM; size is unchanged and no statistic moves.
Changes the DC and target count of a vehicle's Run Over; vehicle- and target-side, resolved by the GM.
An activity: area sonic damage with save-based conditions on targets.
An activity: Stride twice with Shoves, granting temporary Hit Points on success; table-resolved, no standing statistic.
An impulse that creates a wall of stone; a battlefield effect resolved at the table.

Ignores stone difficult terrain, removes off-guard while Balancing on stone, and upgrades a success to a critical success; terrain and degree-of-success rulings the GM applies, with no numeric bonus to any sheet statistic.
A reaction: an Athletics check that knocks the triggering creature prone or makes it fall with you; target-side.
Spellshape that turns squares of the spell's area into difficult terrain; a battlefield effect, not a player statistic.

Grants the critical specialization effects of the character's arcane bonded weapon (the second half, the -2 penalty to saves, is target-side). critSpec must be paired with critSpecWeapons, but the bonded weapon is chosen during play and cannot be enumerated in the record, so no existing field can express "crit spec with whatever weapon is your arcane bond".
An impulse: area damage, forced movement, and a mud condition on targets.
An activity producing random fortune/misfortune effects on rolls at the table; nothing standing on the sheet.
A reaction resolved at the table: forced movement, prone, stunned, and a flat check to minimise the triggering damage.
Legacy duplicate of the same reaction; a table-resolved damage-reduction reaction with no sheet statistic.
A reaction: a Reflex save against a giant's attack that avoids or halves damage and lets you Stride; resolved at the table.
A reaction that lets you Crawl twice without provoking; movement resolved at the table.
An action that stabilizes a dying ally and lowers persistent-damage flat-check DCs for that ally; only the target's state changes.
Extra distance moved on a successful Climb and a 10-foot reach for rope-based Athletics maneuvers; per-check movement and maneuver range are table-resolved, not a Speed or a bonus on the sheet.

Grants a real climb Speed of 15 feet (limited to ropes and similar objects), which nothing delivers. The rest (success-to-critical-success upgrades, not off-guard) is a degree-of-success ruling and rides along as a note. The climb Speed is conditional, so it belongs in a mode rather than the unconditional speeds field.

mode.name: On Ropes (Rope Runner)
mode.duration: while climbing or balancing on a rope or similar object
mode.note: You aren't off-guard while Climbing or Balancing on a rope or similar object, and a success on an Athletics check to Climb or an Acrobatics check to Balance is a critical success instead.

records.reason: A deviant ability: a ranged attack that damages and sickens the target; resolved at the table.
An impulse that summons three trees with their own stat block; a summoned-creature effect the app resolves at the table, not a player statistic.
Extends how long you can go without food or water and avoids precipitation fatigue during overland travel; downtime/exploration survival the app does not model.
As printed here it only lets you exchange one prepared spell for a curriculum or sin spell of the same rank when you Refocus; a play-time preparation swap, not a standing sheet value.
Teaches the animal companion an activity it performs at the table; it changes no player statistic and adds no companion statistic that COMPANION_MODS models.
An action combining movement with a reload Interact; resolved at the table.
An activity combining movement or a jump with a Grapple or Shove; resolved at the table.
A reaction that lets you Stride toward the triggering creature; movement resolved at the table.
Ghost Touch only removes the halving of physical damage against incorporeal creatures, which the app resolves on the target's side of the damage calculation; nothing on the player's sheet changes.
An exploration activity that heals creatures who stay in an area for 10 minutes; downtime/exploration healing resolved at the table.
Legacy alignment-damage substitution on ki focus spells, chosen per cast and only against alignment-opposed creatures; a pre-remaster damage-type ruling made at the table.
Applies only on a critical hit against a fiend; the extra weapon damage die is a crit-only, creature-type-gated rider and the rest (enfeebled 2, clumsy 2) lands on the target.
A reaction that trades armor Hit Points for damage reduction on one Strike; resolved at the table, and the armor's broken state is item bookkeeping.
Spellshape that excludes you from your own spell's area; a per-cast targeting ruling with no standing statistic.
